headline: Exclusive: Firm proposes wind-powered vessel factory to create jobs, build inter-island transport links
summary: A Barbadian company is proposing a fleet of wind-and-battery-powered vessels and a factory to build them. The company says the project could create jobs and address inter-island transport barriers in the Caribbean.
why: Inter-island shipping costs and reliability are a constraint on Caribbean trade and tourism. Proposed low-emission vessel projects can alter transport options for regional businesses.
